name: node-ctl
description: Disposable dev machines on Hetzner Cloud and Contabo, reached over Tailscale

scripts.check: bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run knip
scripts.build: bun build --compile --target=${NODE_CTL_TARGET:-bun} --minify --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --no-compile-autoload-bunfig --define NODE_CTL_VERSION="\"${NODE_CTL_VERSION:-dev}\"" --define NODE_CTL_SHA="\"$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)\"" src/cli.ts --outfile ${NODE_CTL_OUTFILE:-dist/node-ctl} && rm -f .*.bun-build
